title: The phase-4 sample draws judge-confirmed sources at a rate that bounds stale confirms, and the report states their agreement
goal: census.py sample draws the sources the batch judge confirmed as a group of their own at 0.10 (a --judged flag, the changed group's rate), which bounds the expected stale confirms (the judge's measured false confirms were 3 of 29 changed units), and the census report states their sample agreement apart from the other confirmed sources.

clauses.clause: census.py sample draws the sources the batch judge confirmed as a group of their own at 0.10 (a --judged flag, the changed group's rate), which bounds the expected stale confirms (the judge's measured false confirms were 3 of 29 changed units)
the census report states their sample agreement apart from the other confirmed sources

gates.question: At what fraction does census.py sample draw the judge-confirmed sources (the changed group draws 0.10, the other confirmed sources 0.05)?
What name does the phase-4 sample give the group of sources the batch judge confirmed (its CSV group column and the brief's heads)?

notes: Premise: census.sampled puts a source the judge confirmed in the ok group at the ok rate (0.05), with no group of its own. Premise run 2026-10-12: 100 planted confirmed rows noted 'judged supported by' gave 5 drawn, groups={ok}; reproduces. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 8 of 19, "Census and fact diff: anchor runs write only their own rows, judge confirms are sampled, cost figures are measured"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed.
